_note: Phase 4.1 output. The supplied LLM key authenticates but the organization has no credits (HTTP 429 insufficient_quota), so this library was authored by hand rather than generated. It uses exactly the field set MiroFish's oasis_profile_generator emits, so a generated library can replace this file verbatim. Every role and every journey in persona-library.schema.json is covered by at least one persona. Re-generate with: node loadtest/personas/build-personas.mjs --count 12

personas.name: Arun Menon
personas.bio: Runs a 400-hectare reforestation project in Kerala. Technically fluent and impatient with paperwork; wants credits issued quickly but keeps evidence files tidy because buyers ask for them.

personas.name: Fatima Al-Sayed
personas.bio: Cookstove-distribution developer working across three countries. Splits batches per buyer to keep accounting clean, and re-checks every split's lineage before shipping credits.

personas.name: Helena Costa
personas.bio: Independent verifier with 12 years in environmental auditing. Stakes carefully, reads every IPFS hash before approving, and documents challenges in detail before filing them.

personas.name: Tomás Herrera
personas.bio: Soil-carbon verifier who stakes aggressively to win mandates, then defends each approval in public. Occasionally tests whether an expired window really blocks a challenge.

personas.name: Sam Okafor
personas.bio: Corporate sustainability manager buying offsets for an annual disclosure. Cares about one thing: an auditable retirement certificate issued in her company's name.

personas.name: Lee Wan
personas.bio: Trader who flips small lots of credits. Lists, cancels and re-lists constantly, and probes boundaries such as splitting a batch twice to see what the contract allows.

personas.name: Grace Mwangi
personas.bio: First-time buyer at a small logistics firm, buying through a browser with no prior crypto experience. Gives up when a transaction fails and does not come back the same day.

personas.name: Dmitri Volkov
personas.bio: Desk trader who runs several browsers in parallel and races listings with competitors. Treats every revert as information rather than a failure.

personas.name: Panel delegate (rotating)
personas.bio: Acts for the 3-of-5 regulator panel. Only moves when evidence is already on-chain, and expects to be audited for every approval.

personas.name: Nadia Rahman
personas.bio: Second panel seat, acting as an inspector. Reads the challenge evidence, then deliberately tries to resolve a challenge twice and to approve without a proposal, to confirm the panel's guards hold.
